title: Scorcher
overview:
Ever been fried at 30 frames per second?

The adrenaline overload... The synaptic surge... The complete loss of reason as 32,000 colors blaze past you in a magnificent blur. This 3-D racer puts players behind the wheel of a futuristic cyber-cycle while maneuvering through a manic barrage of twists, turns, dips, pits, jumps, tubes, tunnels, bridges, chicanes, barriers, and concrete stretches all presented in full 3-D futuristic landscapes.

Scorcher. Blink and you're history.

- Ultra fast racing action with the most realistic physics to date.
- Six fully 3-D tracks.
- Two modes - Championship and Lap Attack give players a full range of racing styles.
- A mind-melting 32,768 colors brings to life the most compelling virtual world on any game system.
